mostWorthwhile.text: Opening and diagnosing the terminal made the subsequent repairs understandable, and waking Moth gave the work a personality and a connection to the larger problem.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cleaning the contacts and replacing the ribbon were straightforward successive repairs; satisfying in detail, but not especially demanding decisions.

surprise.text: Moth's cached map treats the neighborhood as a service gap even though people and businesses are clearly there.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the terminal's visible faults explained the repairs, and the saved rejection gave Moth a clear question to investigate.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the neighbors challenge the directory before migration, especially after Moth's map showed how the error affects deliveries.
